request.prompt: Image 1 is the character reference sheet for the masked person. Black-and-white high-key 35mm film photograph, overexposed and airy, blown-out whites, heavy film grain, faint photocopy halftone texture, slight softness, editorial fashion photography. Everything is monochrome grey EXCEPT the green paper ghost mask, which stays saturated green — the only colour in the picture. Lots of empty white negative space. Compose for a 16:9 crop. No text, no letters, no logos, no watermark. Extreme close-up, odd crop: the green crumpled-paper ghost mask fills the right half of the frame, only one black plus-sign eye and the edge of one off-white pixel headphone visible, the left half is pure blown-out white. Paper texture sharp. Of the masked person exactly as in the reference image: a boxy green crumpled-paper pixel ghost mask covering the whole head, two black plus-sign eyes, pixel zigzag bottom edge; chunky off-white pixel-block headphones with a small black boom microphone; oversized beige hoodie, wide black jeans, white sneakers.
